scientific.integrity: The open primary full text was inspected at the complete collected system (12), the mutation-simulation section, and the figure captions reporting the positive initial variant seed. The equation page and mutation-simulation pages were visually inspected. Related active-particle mutation literature and a closely related later article by the same authors were checked for broader coverage. The bundled symbolic checker verifies the invariant-face substitution. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The theorem concerns system (12) as printed and does not determine whether unavailable simulation code contained an additional mutation source. It does not question real viral mutation or the mathematical validity of studying competition after a positive variant seed.

title: The printed COVID-19 variant system preserves the variant-free face
